literal: Three soldiers left camp to loot; they were flogged as a warning to the masses, and what they had seized was divided and granted to those at the Emperor's side.
idiomatic: Three soldiers left camp to plunder; they were flogged before the troops as an example, and the loot was divided among those around the Emperor.

literal: On renchen day Li Jiqian had a grievance with his elder brother Jipeng and begged for restored relations; the Emperor knew it was not sincere and refused.
idiomatic: On renchen day Li Jiqian, who was at odds with his elder brother Jipeng, asked to restore friendly relations; the Emperor knew the request was insincere and refused.

literal: On guisi day the armies were ordered to hurry to Yi Prefecture.
idiomatic: On guisi day the court ordered the armies to hurry to Yi Prefecture.

literal: On jihai day followers of the retinue were forbidden to cut down the people's mulberry trees and ancestral homes.
idiomatic: On jihai day the retinue was forbidden to damage civilians' mulberry trees and homesteads.

literal: On guimao day Yi Prefecture was attacked; Song troops came out from Suicheng to reinforce; the Iron Forest Army was sent to strike them and five of their commanders were captured.
idiomatic: On guimao day the army attacked Yi Prefecture; Song troops came out from Suicheng to reinforce, and the Iron Forest Army was sent against them and captured five commanders.

literal: On jiachen day the main army advanced together, took Yi Prefecture, and Prefect Liu Chi surrendered; defending soldiers on the walls fled south; the Emperor led troops to intercept them, and none dared come out.
idiomatic: On jiachen day the main army advanced together, broke Yi Prefecture, and Prefect Liu Chi surrendered; the garrison fled south over the walls, and when the Emperor led troops to cut them off none dared emerge.

literal: Ma Zhi was immediately made prefect and Zhao Zhi military superintendent.
idiomatic: Ma Zhi was immediately appointed prefect and Zhao Zhi military superintendent.

literal: The people and troops of Yi Prefecture were moved to Yanjing.
idiomatic: The soldiers and civilians of Yi Prefecture were relocated to Yanjing.

literal: Because Xian Shou, son of Tokyo cavalry commander Xia Zhenxian, was first to scale the wall, he was appointed prefect of Gaozhou.
idiomatic: Because Xian Shou, son of Tokyo cavalry commander Xia Zhenxian, was first over the wall, he was appointed prefect of Gaozhou.

literal: On yisi day the court visited Yi Prefecture, ascended the Five-Flower Tower, and comforted and reassured officials and commoners.
idiomatic: On yisi day the court visited Yi Prefecture, ascended the Five-Flower Tower, and reassured officials and commoners.

literal: On bingwu day the blue ox and white horse were sacrificed to Heaven and Earth.
idiomatic: On bingwu day the court sacrificed the blue ox and white horse to Heaven and Earth.

literal: An edict announced policy to the three capitals and the various circuits.
idiomatic: An edict announced policy to the three capitals and the various circuits.

literal: On wushen day the court halted at Lishui and paid respects at Emperor Jingzong's temple.
idiomatic: On wushen day the court halted at Lishui and visited Emperor Jingzong's temple.

literal: An edict ordered Zhuo Prefecture prefect Yelü Shouxiong to escort eight hundred Yi Prefecture submitters and return them to their original registers.
idiomatic: An edict ordered Zhuo Prefecture prefect Yelü Shouxiong to escort eight hundred Yi Prefecture submitters home to their original jurisdictions.

literal: On jiyou day the court halted at Qigou and shot ghost arrows.
idiomatic: On jiyou day the court halted at Qigou and shot ghost arrows.

literal: On xinhai day the court returned and halted at Nanjing; the six armies stood down.
idiomatic: On xinhai day the court returned to Nanjing and the six armies stood down.

literal: Second month, renzi new moon: the Emperor attended Yuanhe Hall and received the congratulations of the hundred officials.
idiomatic: On the renzi new moon of the second month the Emperor attended Yuanhe Hall and received congratulations from the hundred officials.

literal: An edict ordered two hundred households from Jibi Fort to move and settle in Tan, Shun, and Ji prefectures.
idiomatic: An edict ordered two hundred households from Jibi Fort to relocate to Tan, Shun, and Ji prefectures.

literal: On jiayin day the Uyghur, Khotan, Shizi, and other states came with tribute.
idiomatic: On jiayin day the Uyghur, Khotan, Shizi, and other states came with tribute.

literal: On yimao day the soldiers were feasted grandly, with titles and rewards granted in differing amounts.
idiomatic: On yimao day the court feasted the soldiers and granted titles and rewards according to rank.

literal: Commissioner of Military Affairs Han Derang was enfeoffed King of Chu; Imperial Son-in-law Commandant Xiao Ningyuan was made co-chancellor of the Secretariat under the same authority as Chief Councillor.
idiomatic: Commissioner of Military Affairs Han Derang was enfeoffed King of Chu, and imperial son-in-law commandant Xiao Ningyuan was made co-chancellor of the Secretariat.

literal: That same day the court visited Changchun Palace.
idiomatic: That same day the court visited Changchun Palace.

literal: On jiazi day an edict ordered that captives from the southern campaign whose kinsmen had been assigned to various tents should be redeemed with official funds so they could be reunited.
idiomatic: On jiazi day an edict ordered that captives from the southern campaign whose relatives had been assigned to various tents be redeemed with official funds so they could rejoin their families.

literal: On yichou day the Jurchen army of the southern campaign was rewarded and sent east to return.
idiomatic: On yichou day the Jurchen army of the southern campaign was rewarded and sent back east.

literal: On bingyin day anonymous letters by examination candidates and slander against the court were forbidden.
idiomatic: On bingyin day anonymous letters by examination candidates and slander against the court were forbidden.

literal: On guiyou day the Tibetans and Tangut came to offer congratulations.
idiomatic: On guiyou day the Tibetans and Tangut came to offer congratulations.

literal: On jiaxu day Yun Prefecture requested that land tax be paid only within its own circuit; it was granted.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day Yun Prefecture asked that land tax be paid only within its own circuit, and the request was granted.

literal: On bingzi day the Jurchen Huogude was made chieftain of his own division.
idiomatic: On bingzi day the Jurchen Huogude was made chieftain of his own division.

literal: Shamans were dispatched separately to sacrifice at famous mountains and great rivers.
idiomatic: Shamans were dispatched separately to sacrifice at famous mountains and great rivers.

literal: On dingchou day the prince Fobaonu was born.
idiomatic: On dingchou day Prince Fobaonu was born.

literal: On wuyin day Arsalan, Khotan, and Xialie all sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On wuyin day Arsalan, Khotan, and Xialie all sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Third month, renwu new moon: envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at Mount Muye.
idiomatic: On the renwu new moon of the third month envoys were sent to sacrifice at Mount Muye.

literal: Grazing and pasturing that harmed the grain crop were forbidden.
idiomatic: Grazing and pasturing that damaged the grain crop were forbidden.

literal: Seventeen Song jinshi came with their families to submit; the authorities were ordered to examine those who had passed at the top level and appoint them National University officers, the rest to be given county recorder or bailiff posts.
idiomatic: Seventeen Song jinshi came with their families to submit; the court ordered examination of top graduates for National University posts, with the rest appointed county recorders or bailiffs.

literal: Li Jiqian sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: Li Jiqian sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On dinghai day an edict ordered Yi Prefecture administrator Zhao Zhi to gather the bones of soldiers killed in battle and build a victory mound.
idiomatic: On dinghai day an edict ordered Yi Prefecture administrator Zhao Zhi to gather the bones of soldiers killed in battle and build a victory mound.

literal: On wuzi day yuyue Song King was granted red pearl thread and ordered to enter the inner spirit tent to perform the rebirth rite; the Empress Dowager granted gifts in great abundance.
idiomatic: On wuzi day yuyue Song King was granted red pearl thread and ordered to enter the inner spirit tent to perform the rebirth rite; the Empress Dowager gave lavish gifts.

literal: Eight households of Jibi Fort commoners, Cheng Tinglang and others, were assigned to Feihu.
idiomatic: Eight households from Jibi Fort, Cheng Tinglang and others, were assigned to Feihu.

literal: On jichou day an edict remitted Yun Prefecture's tax arrears.
idiomatic: On jichou day an edict remitted Yun Prefecture's tax arrears.

literal: Yishi King Guanning played cuju; langjun Gao Si of his command let his horse run wild and knocked him dead; an edict ordered Gao Si's crime investigated.
idiomatic: Yishi King Guanning was playing cuju when langjun Gao Si of his command let his horse run wild and killed him; an edict ordered an inquiry into Gao Si's guilt.

literal: On bingshen day an edict ordered the Qifeng road opened to reach Yi Prefecture market.
idiomatic: On bingshen day an edict ordered the Qifeng road opened to reach the Yi Prefecture market.

literal: On wuxu day the daughter of Prince's Tent Yelü Xiang was enfeoffed Princess Yicheng and given in marriage to Li Jiqian.
idiomatic: On wuxu day the daughter of Prince's Tent Yelü Xiang was enfeoffed Princess Yicheng and given in marriage to Li Jiqian.

literal: That spring the court encamped at Yanfang Marsh.
idiomatic: That spring the court encamped at Yanfang Marsh.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on jiayin day the court returned to the capital.
idiomatic: On jiayin day in the fourth summer month the court returned to the capital.

literal: On yimao day Imperial Uncle Grand Preceptor Xiao Talan requested on behalf of his son Paiya marriage to the Princess Yan Shou; it was granted.
idiomatic: On yimao day Imperial Uncle Grand Preceptor Xiao Talan asked on behalf of his son Paiya to marry Princess Yan Shou, and the request was granted.

literal: On bingchen day the court paid respects at Emperor Taizong's temple.
idiomatic: On bingchen day the court visited Emperor Taizong's temple.

literal: Censor-in-chief Wugu was made to oversee Yishi Great King.
idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Wugu was put in charge of Yishi Great King.

literal: On jiwei day the court visited Yanshou Temple and fed the monks.
idiomatic: On jiwei day the court visited Yanshou Temple and fed the monks.

literal: On jiazi day Remonstrance and Review Grand Master Ma Dechen, because the Emperor loved striking the ball, submitted a forceful remonstrance: "Your servant has observed that when Your Majesty is free after attending court, you take striking the ball for pleasure.
idiomatic: On jiazi day Remonstrance and Review Grand Master Ma Dechen, because the Emperor loved playing cuju, submitted a forceful memorial: "Your servant observes that in leisure after court Your Majesty takes pleasure in striking the ball.

literal: Your servant considers this matter has three points of unfitness: above and below divide into teams, ruler and minister compete for victory, when the ruler gains the minister snatches away, when the ruler loses the minister rejoices — the first unfitness;
idiomatic: Your servant sees three reasons this is unwise: ruler and subject divide into teams and compete; when the ruler wins a minister steals the credit, and when the ruler loses the ministers rejoice — a first objection;

literal: Coming and going interweave, front and rear block one another, competitive spirits rise together, ritual deportment is wholly abandoned; if one grasps greedily for the mallet and by mistake brushes the imperial robe, the minister has already lost propriety yet the ruler can hardly reprove — the second unfitness;
idiomatic: Players weave back and forth and block one another, competitive spirits flare up, and ritual deportment is cast aside; if one lunges for the mallet and brushes the imperial robe by mistake, the minister has already lost propriety yet the ruler can hardly reprove him — a second objection;

literal: To treat lightly the dignity of the ten-thousand-chariot ruler and pursue the amusement of a broad field — though the ground is level it is very hard, though the horses are good they also start and stumble; or through rush and collision one loses control — can the sacred person truly be without harm?
idiomatic: To treat lightly the dignity of the sovereign and pursue the amusement of a broad field — though the ground looks level it is very hard, and though the horses are good they can still start and stumble; in the rush of play control may be lost — can the sacred person truly escape harm?

literal: Would the Empress Dowager not be alarmed and afraid?
idiomatic: Would the Empress Dowager not be alarmed and afraid?

literal: The third unfitness.
idiomatic: That is the third objection.

literal: Your servant hopes Your Majesty will reflect on the weight of succession and cease this dangerous game.
idiomatic: Your servant hopes Your Majesty will reflect on the weight of succession and cease this dangerous game.

literal: " When the memorial was submitted, it was greatly praised and accepted.
idiomatic: " When the memorial was submitted, the Emperor greatly praised it and accepted the advice.

literal: On dingmao day Tuhun Huanjin, Uyghur Anjin, Tibetan Duduo, and others who had come from Song to submit were all granted clothing and belts.
idiomatic: On dingmao day Tuhun Huanjin, Uyghur Anjin, Tibetan Duduo, and others who had defected from Song were all granted clothing and belts.

literal: The Empress Dowager visited the Qishou Khagan temple.
idiomatic: The Empress Dowager visited the Qishou Khagan temple.

literal: On bingzi day Yelü Yao of the Sheli army was made changgun.
idiomatic: On bingzi day Yelü Yao of the Sheli army was appointed changgun.

literal: On jimao day the court encamped at Longquan in Ru Prefecture.
idiomatic: On jimao day the court encamped at Longquan in Ru Prefecture.

literal: Fifth month, gengchen new moon: Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Puling and others were dispatched to lead troops by separate routes to guard against Song.
idiomatic: On the gengchen new moon of the fifth month Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Puling and others were dispatched to lead troops by separate routes against Song.

literal: Yaolian deputy envoy Kongguli was made Sheli zhailie xiangwen.
idiomatic: Yaolian deputy envoy Kongguli was appointed Sheli zhailie xiangwen.

literal: On xinsi day the Wind Lord was sacrificed to at Baima Village in Ru Prefecture.
idiomatic: On xinsi day the court sacrificed to the Wind Lord at Baima Village in Ru Prefecture.

literal: Xiuge led his army to Mancheng, recruited over seven hundred surrendering soldiers, sent envoys to present them; an edict ordered them assigned to Eastern Capital.
idiomatic: Xiuge led his army to Mancheng, recruited more than seven hundred surrendering soldiers, and sent envoys to present them; an edict ordered them assigned to Eastern Capital.

literal: On xinmao day they hunted along the Sanggan River.
idiomatic: On xinmao day the court hunted along the Sanggan River.

literal: On renchen day Yanjing reported Song troops had reached the border; because of the heat they did not yet dare give battle, but would encamp at Yi Prefecture and, if the enemy moved, advance and strike; if they withdrew, withdraw the army.
idiomatic: On renchen day Yanjing reported that Song troops had reached the border; because of the summer heat they did not yet dare give battle but would encamp at Yi Prefecture and advance if the enemy moved, or withdraw if the enemy retreated.

literal: It was approved.
idiomatic: The court agreed.

literal: Sixth month, gengxu new moon: Grand Preceptor Zhemu, for pandering, was beaten twenty blows.
idiomatic: On the gengxu new moon of the sixth month Grand Preceptor Zhemu was beaten twenty blows for pandering.

literal: On xinyou day an edict permitted the people to farm wasteland in Yanle and Miyun counties, remitting tax and corvée for ten years.
idiomatic: On xinyou day an edict permitted people to farm wasteland in Yanle and Miyun counties and remitted tax and corvée for ten years.

literal: On jiaxu day Xuanzheng Hall academician Ma Dechen died; an edict posthumously granted him Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent, ten thousand coins, and a hundred piculs of grain.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day Xuanzheng Hall academician Ma Dechen died; an edict posthumously granted him Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent, ten thousand coins, and a hundred piculs of grain.

literal: On yihai day an edict ordered livestock distributed to impoverished people of the border tribes.
idiomatic: On yihai day an edict ordered livestock distributed to impoverished people of the border tribes.

literal: That month Xiuge and Paiya defeated Song troops at Taizhou.
idiomatic: That month Xiuge and Paiya defeated Song troops at Taizhou.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on yiyou day the Emperor attended court at the Cool Hall.
idiomatic: On yiyou day in the seventh autumn month the Emperor held court at the Cool Hall.

literal: On bingxu day Vice Censor-in-chief Yelü Hemaike was made acting yilibi; Horizontal Tent langjun Yelü Yanshou was made censor-in-chief.
idiomatic: On bingxu day Vice Censor-in-chief Yelü Hemaike was made acting yilibi, and Horizontal Tent langjun Yelü Yanshou was appointed censor-in-chief.

literal: On guisi day troops were dispatched on a southern campaign.
idiomatic: On guisi day troops were dispatched on a southern campaign.

literal: On jiawu day four men each from the Dilibi, Nielie, and Wuhei divisions were added to Eastern North Road envoy Bolide, and seals and cords were granted.
idiomatic: On jiawu day four men each from the Dilibi, Nielie, and Wuhei divisions were added to Eastern North Road envoy Bolide, and seals and cords were granted.

literal: On dingyou day the southern campaign troops and officers were rewarded.
idiomatic: On dingyou day the court rewarded the southern campaign troops and officers.

literal: That same day the Emperor and Empress Dowager visited Emperor Jingzong's temple.
idiomatic: That same day the Emperor and Empress Dowager visited Emperor Jingzong's temple.

literal: Eighth month, on gengwu day jinshi Gao Zheng and one other were passed and granted degree.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengwu day, jinshi Gao Zheng and one other passed the examinations.

literal: Winter, tenth month: snares and nets for catching rabbits were forbidden.
idiomatic: In the tenth winter month snares and nets for catching rabbits were forbidden.

literal: Eleventh month, on jiashen day Khotan's Zhang Wenbao presented an inner elixir book.
idiomatic: On jiashen day in the eleventh month Khotan's Zhang Wenbao presented an inner elixir book.

literal: Twelfth month, on jiayin day ice fishing was conducted at Shenzi Marsh.
idiomatic: On jiayin day in the twelfth month the court went ice fishing at Shenzi Marsh.

literal: On guihai day they hunted at Haocao Ridge.
idiomatic: On guihai day the court hunted at Haocao Ridge.
